label: Facilities meeting the MCH quality standard
plain_language: Only about 1 in 10 primary health facilities scored the 80% needed to 'meet' the maternal & child health quality standard.
headline: yes

label: Maternal death reviews (MPDSR)
plain_language: The best-implemented indicator: most facilities ran maternal death reviews per national guidelines, though acting on what they find takes functional teams.
headline: yes

label: Integrated management tools (IMPAC)
plain_language: Just over half had the essential checklists, charts and protocols for integrated management in pregnancy and childcare.

label: Family planning to guidelines
plain_language: Fewer than half followed family planning guidelines on method availability, informed choice and staff training.

label: Partogram completed correctly
plain_language: A partogram tracks labour to catch danger signs early; fewer than half completed it correctly.

label: Immunisation to guidelines
plain_language: Under half met national immunisation standards, including cold-chain equipment and trained staff.

label: Child growth monitoring (IMCI)
plain_language: Four in ten offered quality child growth monitoring following IMCI guidelines.

label: Antenatal care to guidelines
plain_language: Only four in ten followed antenatal care guidelines across the seven routine ANC services checked.

label: Staff trained in BEmONC/CEmONC
plain_language: Under 4 in 10 had a staff member trained in emergency obstetric and newborn care in the past two years.

label: BEmONC/CEmONC services provided
plain_language: Fewer still actually provided the emergency obstetric and newborn signal functions, often because the equipment isn't there.

label: Emergency obstetric supplies available
plain_language: Only 1 in 6 facilities had the key obstetric medicines and supplies needed to manage childbirth emergencies.

label: Postnatal & newborn care space
plain_language: Among the 394 hospitals and health centres, only 60 offered postnatal and essential newborn care with dedicated neonatal and Kangaroo Mother Care space.

label: Cervical cancer screening offered
plain_language: The single weakest area: fewer than 1 in 12 facilities offered cervical cancer screening and treatment.
headline: yes
